# Coverage of go-lisp (.lgo) files is reported in go-lisp positions.

go test -cover ./sign
stdout 'coverage: 80.0% of statements' # the same as for the equivalent Go code

go test -coverprofile=c.out ./sign
grep '^example.com/cov/sign/sign.lgo:4\.3,5\.5 1 1$' c.out
grep '^example.com/cov/sign/sign.lgo:5\.5,5\.25 1 0$' c.out
grep '^example.com/cov/sign/sign.lgo:6\.3,' c.out
! grep 'sign_test' c.out

go tool cover -func=c.out
stdout 'sign.lgo:3:\s+Classify\s+80.0%'

go tool cover -html=c.out -o c.html
grep 'sign.lgo' c.html

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cov

go 1.28
-- sign/sign.lgo --
(package sign)

(func classify [-n int] [string]
  (if (< -n 0)
    (return "negative"))
  (if (== -n 0)
    (return "zero"))
  (return "positive"))
-- sign/sign_test.lgo --
(package sign)

(import "testing")

(func test-classify [-t (* testing.T)] []
  (if (!= (classify 0) "zero") (-t.error "0"))
  (if (!= (classify 1) "positive") (-t.error "1")))
